title: HALean engine protocol v1 (JSON lines over stdin/stdout)
description: Every input line gets exactly one output line: a batch of commands. All times are Unix milliseconds (UTC); 'tz' is the local UTC offset in seconds at 'now'. The engine never reads a clock.

automations.description: HA automation configs (automations.yaml entries) as JSON

tick.description: Send at least once per second; time triggers, for-timers and delays only advance on input.

qos.description: The qos the message was delivered with

mqtt.description: An MQTT message as HA's MQTT client receives it from the broker; it reaches every mqtt trigger whose topic filter matches.

data.description: await request.post(): form fields as [name, value] pairs, in order

query.description: request.query as [name, value] pairs, in order

local.description: The request counts as local for local_only webhooks (not a cloud connection, remote address in a local network)

error_kind.description: invalid = vol.Invalid/config errors (never swallowed); ha_error = HomeAssistantError; other = any other exception

response.description: The service's response data, when the call asked for it (return_response). For such a call, ok without a dict response is taken as HA's ServiceRegistry.async_call takes it: a HomeAssistantError (service_reponse_invalid) in the calling step.

return_response.description: The step has a response_variable: ask for the response and send it back as service_result.response.

oneOf.description: Blocking call: answer with service_result carrying the same call_id.
Only in the reply to init (and, for scripts, reload): this automation or script (object id) was not loaded and should stay in HA.
halean-script: write the state of a script entity it owns (on/off, unavailable once removed by a reload).

response.description: When ok: the response (null unless return_response).

oneOf.description: halean-script: the answer to a script_call with the same call_id.

script_init.description: halean-script: like init, with scripts. A script.* state in states restores that script's last_triggered. Optional automations run in the same engine (after the scripts), so their calls of script.* run these scripts.

automations.description: As in init; rejected ones are reported as unsupported with their id

scripts.description: scripts.yaml as ordered [object_id, config] pairs (bridge/protocol.py protocol_scripts)

script_call.description: halean-script: a call of script.<service> (an object id, turn_on, turn_off or toggle), blocking like ServiceRegistry.async_call(blocking=True). Answered by call_done.

data.description: service data with the target merged in

script_reload.description: halean-script: script.reload with the new scripts.yaml.

error.description: The input line could not be decoded; engine state is unchanged.
